title: U SWITCHES WHAT G THROWS, THE HIGHLIGHT STAYS ON THE GUN
why: His decision of 2026-10-13: U picks which of the two throwable keys the G key throws, and the highlight stays on the gun. U used to move the highlight to the grenade cell, which took the trigger off the gun. It now switches the kind G throws between the grenades on keys 5 and 6 (and says so, SMOKE CANISTER READY), and the highlight does not move; pressing key 5 or 6 still selects that cell so the trigger cooks it. G throws the kind on the throwable key U chose, and if the hand was left on a kind that no key shows it throws a kind that is on a key. With no grenade on a key U says NO THROWABLE ON THE TACTICAL BELT or NO THROWABLES LEFT.
now: U now switches which of the two throwable keys G throws, and the highlight stays on the gun.
